{"task":{"request":"Write one read-only SQLite query. Include every project ordered by id. Output project_id, active_task_count, successful_latest_count. Active tasks have archived=0. Return {sql:string}.","schema":"CREATE TABLE projects(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE tasks(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, project_id INTEGER, archived INTEGER); CREATE TABLE attempts(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, task_id INTEGER, finished_at INTEGER, status TEXT);"},"loaded_skills":{"sql":"Use only a SELECT statement or WITH followed by SELECT. Preserve integer cents and do not assume hidden uniqueness constraints."},"handoff":{"proposals":[{"candidate":{"answer":{"sql":"WITH active_tasks AS (SELECT id AS task_id, project_id FROM tasks WHERE archived = 0), ranked_attempts AS (SELECT task_id, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY task_id ORDER BY finished_at DESC, id DESC) AS rn FROM attempts), project_counts AS (SELECT at.project_id, COUNT(at.task_id) AS active_task_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_latest_count FROM active_tasks AS at LEFT JOIN ranked_attempts AS ra ON ra.task_id = at.task_id AND ra.rn = 1 GROUP BY at.project_id) SELECT p.id AS project_id, COALESCE(pc.active_task_count, 0) AS active_task_count, COALESCE(pc.successful_latest_count, 0) AS successful_latest_count FROM projects AS p LEFT JOIN project_counts AS pc ON pc.project_id = p.id ORDER BY p.id"},"uncertainties":[]}}],"routing":{"policy":"parallel","selected_skill":"sql","risk_reasons":[],"review_triggered":true,"path":"selective_review","gate_errors":[["Return an object with exactly the answer key.","Malformed uncertainty list."]]}}}
